name: After recital F – 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of Vukovar
part_text: Fa. whereas the Council of Europe’s opinion on national minorities in Croatia, published on 9 October 2026, called on the Croatian authorities to strengthen the protection of national minorities, in particular by combating hostility, hate speech and discrimination targeting the Serbian minority, lowering the threshold for the official use of minority languages and scripts, including Serbian Cyrillic, and ensuring the effective representation of national minorities in public administration and the judiciary;
